info.name: SmartIntern Backend API
info.description: Local demo API handoff. Uses express-session cookies, not bearer JWT. Send requests selectively; this is an API reference, not a safe full-collection batch runner. CRUD requests change live data. Obtain IDs from catalog and list responses. Use QA records for DELETE. Never import .env or database credentials.

request.description: Role: Public. Expected success: 200. Session cookie authentication. {ok, database}

exec: if (pm.response.code < 400) { const data = pm.response.json(); for (const key of ['internshipId','applicationId','projectId','projectCode','experienceId']) { if (data[key] !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set(key, data[key]); } }
